chunks: Whoever performs a single prayer in al-Masjid al-Haram, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, accepts from him every prayer he has performed and every prayer he will perform until he dies.

key_terms.الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ: the Sacred Mosque in Makkah, the holiest sanctuary in Islam
key_terms.عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ: Mighty and Majestic, an honorific expressing Allah’s greatness
key_terms.قَبِلَ اللَّهُ: Allah accepted, indicating divine acceptance of worship
key_terms.يُصَلِّيهَا: he performs it, referring to prayers he will offer

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for performing one prayer in al-Masjid al-Haram?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the immense virtue of performing salat (prayer) in al-Masjid al-Haram. It emphasizes the extraordinary divine acceptance associated with worship in this sacred place, encouraging believers toward devotion connected to hajj and the Sacred Mosque.
